ddl.where: "product_id" is not null and "provider_tenant_key" is not null
ddl.name: instances_provider_identity_uq

ddl.value: cardinality("event_types") > 0 and array_position("event_types", null) is null
ddl.name: webhook_subscriptions_event_types

ddl.value: ("principal_id" is null and "principal_kind" is null) or ("principal_id" is not null and "principal_kind" is not null and "principal_kind" in ('person','service_principal'))
ddl.name: accounts_principal_pair

ddl.value: ("account_type" not in ('shared','unknown') or "principal_id" is null) and ("account_type" <> 'human' or "principal_kind" is null or "principal_kind" = 'person') and ("account_type" <> 'service' or "principal_kind" is null or "principal_kind" = 'service_principal')
ddl.name: accounts_principal_type

ddl.value: ("committed_amount" is null and "currency" is null) or ("committed_amount" is not null and "currency" is not null and "currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
ddl.name: contracts_committed_amount_pair

ddl.value: "id" is distinct from "parent_contract_id" and "id" is distinct from "supersedes_contract_id" and "id" is distinct from "renews_contract_id"
ddl.name: contracts_not_self_chain

ddl.value: ("capacity_type" = 'fixed' and "quantity" is not null and "quantity" >= 0) or ("capacity_type" in ('unlimited','unknown') and "quantity" is null)
ddl.name: entitlements_capacity

ddl.value: ("service_start_date" is null and "service_end_date" is null) or ("service_start_date" is not null and "service_end_date" is not null and "service_end_date" > "service_start_date")
ddl.name: spend_records_service_interval

ddl.value: ("record_type" in ('invoice_line','credit_line') and "basis" = 'invoiced') or ("record_type" in ('payment_line','refund_line') and "basis" = 'paid') or "record_type" = 'expense_line'
ddl.name: spend_records_basis_type

ddl.value: ("record_type" in ('credit_line','refund_line') and "amount" < 0) or ("record_type" not in ('credit_line','refund_line') and "amount" >= 0)
ddl.name: spend_records_sign

ddl.value: ("reconciliation_status" = 'duplicate' and "canonical_record_id" is not null and "canonical_record_id" <> "id") or ("reconciliation_status" <> 'duplicate' and "canonical_record_id" is null)
ddl.name: spend_records_duplicate_pointer

ddl.value: ("commitment_amount" is null and "currency" is null) or ("commitment_amount" is not null and "currency" is not null and "currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
ddl.name: subscriptions_commitment_amount_pair

ddl.value: ("commitment_amount" is null and "commitment_start_date" is null and "commitment_end_date" is null) or ("commitment_amount" is not null and "commitment_start_date" is not null and "commitment_end_date" is not null and "commitment_end_date" > "commitment_start_date")
ddl.name: subscriptions_commitment_period

ddl.value: "id" is distinct from "supersedes_subscription_id" and "id" is distinct from "renews_subscription_id"
ddl.name: subscriptions_not_self_chain

ddl.value: ("reconciliation_status" = 'duplicate' and "canonical_record_id" is not null and "canonical_record_id" <> "id") or ("reconciliation_status" <> 'duplicate' and "canonical_record_id" is null)
ddl.name: usage_records_duplicate_pointer

ddl.value: "winning_observation_id" is null or "connection_id" is not null
ddl.name: field_provenance_observation_connection

ddl.value: "authority" <> 'source' or ("connection_id" is not null and "winning_observation_id" is not null)
ddl.name: field_provenance_source_required

ddl.value: ("authority" = 'override' and "override_id" is not null) or ("authority" <> 'override' and "override_id" is null)
ddl.name: field_provenance_override_required

ddl.value: "status" not in ('succeeded','partial','failed') or ("accepted_count" + "rejected_count" = "received_count" and "finished_at" is not null)
ddl.name: ingestion_batches_terminal_counts

ddl.value: "status" not in ('succeeded','partial','failed') or "finished_at" is not null
ddl.name: sync_runs_terminal_finished_at

ddl.value: ("status" = 'linked' and "canonical_entity_id" is not null and "canonical_entity_kind" is not null) or ("status" = 'ignored' and "canonical_entity_id" is null and "canonical_entity_kind" is null)
ddl.name: external_object_links_target
